Make this year’s festivities unforgettable by welcoming this magnificent tree into your celebrations!

5313817021799.variantName: 3 Set Christmas Pine Tree Window Clings Static Decorations,green,Holiday Decor, Static Cling, Reusable, Christmas Theme
5313817021799.sourceDescription:
Product Introduction
Add instant Christmas charm to your glass with our glue-free Christmas tree static window clings. Made of eco-friendly PVC static film, these decals feature elegant green, white and gold Christmas trees and snowflakes with double-sided print. No adhesive
 required, no residue after removal. You can adjust the position anytime during installation, and reuse them year after year. Waterproof and lightweight, it is a hassle-free holiday decor pick.
Product Specifications

 Material: PVC static film
 Single sheet: 20 × 30 cm / 7.87 × 11.81 in
 Packing: 3 sheets/set（3set）
 Net weight: 70g
 Design: Classic green & gold Xmas tree with snowflakes
 Feature: Double-sided printing, static adsorption

Application Scenarios
Great for household windows, glass cabinet, mirrors, shop front windows, restaurant glass doors. Fit for Christmas home decor, boutique holiday display, winter party decoration, classroom festive layout, and Christmas gift.
Notes

 Works only on smooth clean glass and mirror, invalid for frosted, uneven or porous surfaces.
 Wipe the glass dry and clean before applying; a small amount of water helps the cling stick better.
 Lay flat on the original backing sheet for storage to avoid creases.
 Do not scrape with hard sharp items.
 Prolonged strong sunlight may affect the color durability.
REALISTIC PINE TREE DESIGNS FOR CHRISTMAS DECOR – Bring the natural beauty of evergreen branches to your holiday displays with christmas window clings. Featuring detailed pine needle patterns and rich green tones, these decorative stickers add a classic woodland touch to windows, complementing vintage christmas decor, winter greenery and traditional seasonal arrangements.
GLUE-FREE STATIC CLING FOR EASY DECORATING – Enjoy festive window displays without applying adhesive. These christmas window stickers use a static cling design that attaches to clean, smooth glass surfaces. Simply position each decoration and smooth it into place.
REMOVABLE & REUSABLE HOLIDAY WINDOW CLINGS – Change your seasonal display without starting over. These holiday window clings can be carefully removed, repositioned and stored for future decorating. Unlike conventional adhesive stickers, the static cling design does not require glue for attachment, making it a practical option for creating different Christmas arrangements throughout the holiday season.
SIMPLE THREE-STEP APPLICATION – Create your holiday window display with minimal preparation. First, clean the glass surface and remove dust. Next, peel the pine tree decoration from its backing and position it on the window. Finally, smooth the surface with a soft cloth or flat card to reduce air bubbles.
VERSATILE CHRISTMAS WINDOW DECORATIONS – Add seasonal greenery to living room windows, balcony glass, entryway panels and retail storefronts. These pine tree window clings pair naturally with traditional Christmas ornaments, vintage christmas stickers and other festive accents.

Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green, red, and white finish and iron construction give them a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Iron. Colour: Green, Red, and White. Stated size: 11.5 cm. Product weight: 0.11 kg. Quantity: 3 pack.
Set of three festive iron ornaments in green, red, and white for Christmas tree decoration.
Each ornament includes a hanging cord for easy attachment to branches or display hooks.
Durable iron construction provides a defined appearance suitable for indoor holiday displays.
Compact size of approximately 11.5 cm allows for versatile placement within any arrangement.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: Hanging Cord
Hanger included

Christmas Decoration
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Key details include removable design.

Removable Design
The removable design allows the relevant part to be taken off when needed. It gives more flexibility when arranging, cleaning or storing the product according to its intended use.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Colour: Clear. Dimensions: 60 mm; 2.36 inch. Quantity: 30 pack.
Clear festive ornaments with a removable design for flexible arranging and easy storage.
Pack of 30 decorative pieces to create a focal point in your Christmas display.
Transparent finish adds a subtle, elegant detail to holiday decorations.
Compact 60 mm size allows for versatile placement on trees or shelves.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 30 pieces

Create a coordinated white Christmas display with this 11cm teardrop bauble. The tapered teardrop has a sparkling upper section, a decorative ribbon band, pearl-style bead detail below and white fur trim at the top. The tapered shape adds a longer outline among round ornaments, bringing variety to a white Christmas tree display. Place the ornament among Christmas tree baubles and ribbon, or incorporate the design into a decorative wreath or garland arrangement. The white finish works with green foliage and pale seasonal accessories, while the detailed surface provides interest when viewed up close. Leave enough space around each piece to show its outline and combine it with your own decorations for a balanced display. Each complete decoration measures 11cm, giving you a size reference when planning the arrangement. This option contains 1 ornament. The design also suits indoor window arrangements, winter wedding decor and Christmas party displays, bringing a consistent white accent to different parts of your seasonal decorating.
White Christmas Ornaments: Includes 1 white teardrop bauble, measuring 11cm. The tapered shape adds a longer outline among round ornaments, bringing variety to a white Christmas tree display. Use the piece with baubles and ribbon to add pearl-style detail to your indoor seasonal display.
Decorative Texture: The tapered teardrop has a sparkling upper section, a decorative ribbon band, pearl-style bead detail below and white fur trim at the top. These details give the ornament definition against green foliage and add interest to white Christmas decorations, wreath arrangements and indoor festive displays.
Seasonal Display Ideas: Position the 11cm teardrop bauble among Christmas tree decorations or include it in a wreath or garland arrangement. Leave space around the teardrop outline so its shape and surface detail remain visible beside your own ribbons, foliage and other ornaments.
White Winter Theme: Combine this decoration with white baubles, pale ribbon or contrasting green foliage to build a winter wonderland display. The teardrop motif also adds a festive detail to indoor window arrangements, seasonal home decor and Christmas party table settings.
Pack And Size Details: The 11cm size refers to each complete ornament. Includes 1 piece for a focal accent. Position among your own tree decorations, bows and foliage to create a festive display for the home, a winter wedding or an indoor seasonal event. Plan the spacing to show the shape.

5056903233699.sourceDescription:
Add wine red colour and contrasting texture to your Christmas decorations with this pack of 3 matching 10cm thread ball baubles. Each round ornament has a thread-wrapped surface with a gold sequin band around the middle, bringing together fine lines and reflective detail in one design. A hanging loop above the decorative cap provides a way to position the bauble on a suitable tree branch or include it in a wreath or garland arrangement. The 10cm size creates a visible accent among foliage, ribbons and other hanging ornaments, while the wine red finish helps you coordinate a consistent seasonal colour scheme. Use the matching pieces to repeat the design across the tree, or combine with your own plain and patterned decorations for a varied display. These Christmas tree ornaments also work in indoor window arrangements, mantel greenery, winter wedding decorations and festive party displays. This option contains 3 baubles, with the same thread covering and sequin-band design on each piece. Display the band facing forward so its sequin detail remains visible between branches.
Thread Ball Baubles: Includes 3 matching 10cm wine red Christmas tree baubles, with a thread-wrapped surface and a gold sequin band around the middle. The round ornaments add colour and texture to Christmas tree decorations, wreaths and garlands, with the same finish on each selected piece.
Sequin Band Detail: The gold band contrasts with the wine red thread covering, combining a textured finish with reflective sequin detail. Place these decorative Christmas balls among foliage and ribbons to add a different surface beside plain baubles in your seasonal arrangement.
Hanging Tree Ornaments: A loop above the decorative cap provides a hanging point for each bauble. Position the 10cm ornaments on suitable branches or incorporate them into a wreath or garland, spacing them between other decorations so the thread texture and sequin band remain visible.
Coordinated Christmas Decor: Use the wine red colour to build a consistent tree theme, or combine the baubles with contrasting ornaments and ribbon. The round shape suits traditional Christmas decorations, winter wedding displays and festive party arrangements around the home.
Display And Pack Contents: Includes 3 matching decorative balls for a repeated accent, each measuring 10cm. Add to indoor window arrangements, mantel greenery or a decorated tree, then coordinate with your own bows, foliage and seasonal accessories for a display throughout the festive season.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display

5037204473199.sourceDescription:
Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its multicoloured finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Colour: Multicoloured. Stated size: 180 x 120 x 155 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Creates a festive focal point with a recognisable Father Christmas motif for your holiday display.
Multicoloured finish is easy to coordinate with existing seasonal decor and surrounding settings.
Versatile decoration that can be displayed alone or as part of a coordinated group arrangement.
Single item pack provides an instant seasonal accent to refresh your home interior.
Guarantee - 1 month

Suitable for: Outdoor use

0646255950099.sourceDescription:
Ready to soak in the Christmas vibe? Our green spruce Christmas tree is ready to visit your lovely home. A natural lifelike appearance presents you with a full and fluffy feeling; Stunning warm lights highlight your Christmas Eve. Premium quality materials ensure this artificial tree durable and sturdy; Bendable branch tips are easy to lift and down for pre-setting; Versatile design allows the whole family to enjoy a fun time decorating at their will. This tree is easy to assemble with a foldable stand and three other sections of the tree body. PVC needles and metal frame gives you a very traditional feel both to the touch.
Natural lifelike appearance: This artificial Christmas tree is hinged with plentiful tips, which give a full and fluffy look from any angle in your decorated places. The Green and thick finish of branch tips enhanced the natural leafy vibe of this decorative holiday tree. Lush tips also leave more space for your other festive ornaments.
Durable materials: All branches and tips are made of premium PVC, which makes it durable and lifelike. Both trunk and the stand are made of iron, ensuring sturdy and balanced placing.
Foldable stand: This stand is foldable for easy storage and packing, you can effortlessly fold it to save more space in the garage or simply wait for another coming year. Four feet of the stand are covered by non-skid rubber each to make sure the tree stands in place, also preventing floor scratches.
Versatile design: Our green spruce artificial tree can be used either indoors or outdoors, the sturdy metal frame is relatively heavier and not likely to collapse. It is an unlit tree with no decoration on it except for branches and tips.
Flexible tips: The “leaves” on our tree can be bent and set at will. After putting the tree body and they stand together, you are supposed to fluff out the tips to give a full look at your unique Christmas tree. All tips are bendable and can be set in a certain direction, normally the fluffing out procedure including two steps: lifting the top tips and pulling out the side tips.
Manufacturer guarantee: 1 month
Artificial christmas tree type: Hinged
Assembly required
Stand included
